references.text: Moses lays his hands on Joshua and gives him authority, fulfilling God's command to appoint Joshua as leader.
God commands Moses to take some of the Spirit that is upon him and place it on the seventy elders, a similar pattern for spiritual transfer.
The Lord takes the Spirit that is upon Moses and places it on the elders, showing how God's Spirit is transferred through the laying on of hands.
Bezalel is filled with God's Spirit, with wisdom and understanding, another example of the Spirit giving wisdom to a chosen leader.
The children of Israel promise to obey Joshua just as they obeyed Moses, fulfilling what is written in Deuteronomy 34:9.
The Spirit of the Lord shall rest upon the Messiah with the spirit of wisdom and understanding, showing the connection between the Spirit and wisdom.
The apostles lay their hands on the seven deacons who were full of the Spirit and wisdom, a similar pattern for appointment into service.
Paul reminds Timothy to fan into flame the gift he received through the laying on of hands, showing the continuity of this practice.
Timothy received his gift through prophetic words and the laying on of hands by the council of elders, showing the same pattern for spiritual transfer.
